sessions.title: Four rounds of box breathing
sessions.subtitle: Two minutes, anywhere, eyes open or closed

steps.name: Settle
steps.cue: Sit or stand. Let your shoulders drop away from your ears.

steps.name: Round one
steps.cue: In for four, hold for four, out for four, hold for four.

steps.name: Round two
steps.cue: Same count. Let the out-breath be the easy part.

steps.name: Round three
steps.cue: If the hold feels long, shorten it. The rhythm matters more than the number.

steps.name: Round four
steps.cue: Last one. Notice whether anything has softened.

sessions.title: Neck and shoulder release
sessions.subtitle: For the hours you spent looking at a screen

steps.name: Shoulder rolls
steps.cue: Big and slow, back and down. Five each way.

steps.name: Ear to shoulder (Right)
steps.cue: Right ear toward right shoulder. Breathe into the long side of the neck.

steps.name: Ear to shoulder (Left)
steps.cue: Left ear toward left shoulder. Same slow breath.

steps.name: Chin tuck
steps.cue: Draw your chin gently back. Small movement, big effect.

steps.name: Chest opener
steps.cue: Hands behind your back, lift the chest, breathe wide.

sessions.title: Three minutes for your hips
sessions.subtitle: Undo a day of sitting

steps.name: Figure four (Right)
steps.cue: On your back, ankle over the opposite knee. Draw the leg in.

steps.name: Figure four (Left)
steps.cue: Same thing, other leg. Keep your lower back heavy.

steps.name: Low lunge (Right)
steps.cue: Front knee over ankle, back hip sinking forward.

steps.name: Low lunge (Left)
steps.cue: Switch legs. Breathe rather than push.

sessions.title: Legs up the wall
sessions.subtitle: The five minutes that reset everything

steps.name: Get set up
steps.cue: Hips close to the wall, legs resting up it. A cushion under your hips if you like.

steps.name: Settle
steps.cue: Arms wide. Let the floor take your weight.

steps.name: Breathe
steps.cue: Long, unhurried out-breaths. Nothing to do here.

steps.name: Come out slowly
steps.cue: Bend your knees, roll to one side, take your time sitting up.

sessions.title: Ninety seconds of jump rope
sessions.subtitle: Short, bouncy, and good for your bones

steps.name: Warm the ankles
steps.cue: Bounce lightly on the spot, no rope. Soft knees.

steps.name: Thirty seconds
steps.cue: Small jumps, barely leaving the floor. Rope or no rope both count.

steps.name: Rest & shake out
steps.cue: Shake it out. Breathe.

steps.name: Thirty more
steps.cue: Last set. Stop early if anything twinges.

sessions.title: Carry something heavy
sessions.subtitle: Three minutes that your grip will thank you for

steps.name: Pick up
steps.cue: One weight in each hand, standing tall.

steps.name: Walk
steps.cue: Walk slowly. Ribs down, shoulders back, breathe.

steps.name: Set down and shake out
steps.cue: Put them down before your grip gives out, not after.

steps.name: Walk again
steps.cue: One more pass. Same posture.

steps.name: Finish
steps.cue: Set down. Open and close your hands a few times.

sessions.title: Five minutes of qi gong
sessions.subtitle: Slow, standing, and surprisingly waking

steps.name: Stand and settle
steps.cue: Feet hip width, knees soft, weight even.

steps.name: Lifting the sky
steps.cue: Arms float up on the in-breath, sink on the out.

steps.name: Turning the waist
steps.cue: Let your arms swing loosely around you. Eyes soft.

steps.name: Drawing down
steps.cue: Hands trace down the front of your body, palms facing you.

steps.name: Stand still
steps.cue: Notice how you feel before you move on with the day.

sessions.title: Ten gentle minutes on the mat
sessions.subtitle: Small, doable, still counts

steps.name: Breathing
steps.cue: On your back, knees bent. Wide ribs on the way in.

steps.name: Pelvic tilts
steps.cue: Rock the pelvis gently. Small range, slow.

steps.name: Dead bug
steps.cue: Opposite arm and leg, lower back staying heavy.

steps.name: Bridge
steps.cue: Peel up one vertebra at a time, roll down the same way.

steps.name: Side-lying leg lifts (Right)
steps.cue: Long body, small controlled lifts.

steps.name: Side-lying leg lifts (Left)
steps.cue: Match it.

steps.name: Knees to chest
steps.cue: Rock side to side. Done.

sessions.title: Twenty minutes of mat Pilates
sessions.subtitle: Controlled, core-led, no equipment

steps.name: Breath and set-up
steps.cue: Find the ribs-down, long-spine position you'll keep all session.

steps.name: The hundred
steps.cue: Pump the arms, breathe in for five, out for five.

steps.name: Roll ups
steps.cue: Slow up, slower down. Use the exhale.

steps.name: Single leg stretch
steps.cue: Switch legs smoothly, shoulders off the mat if it's comfortable.

steps.name: Dead bug
steps.cue: Opposite arm and leg, lower back heavy.

steps.name: Bridge series
steps.cue: Peel up, hold, roll down. Three times.

steps.name: Side plank (Right)
steps.cue: Knees down is a full version, not a lesser one.

steps.name: Side plank (Left)
steps.cue: Match it.

steps.name: Spine stretch
steps.cue: Sit tall, reach forward, roll back up.

sessions.title: Thirty minutes, full body
sessions.subtitle: The one that leaves you taller

steps.name: Warm up
steps.cue: Breath, pelvic tilts, shoulder rolls.

steps.name: The hundred
steps.cue: Set the tone. Steady breath.

steps.name: Roll ups and roll overs
steps.cue: Slow through every vertebra.

steps.name: Leg series
steps.cue: Single leg stretch, double leg stretch, scissors.

steps.name: Bridge series
steps.cue: Add single-leg lifts if it feels good.

steps.name: Side series
steps.cue: Leg lifts, circles, side plank. Both sides.

steps.name: Front support
steps.cue: Plank, then down to child's pose. Twice.

steps.name: Spine stretch and twist
steps.cue: Long, open, unhurried.

steps.name: Finish
steps.cue: Knees to chest, then stand up slowly.

sessions.title: Fifteen minutes with weights
sessions.subtitle: Short, loaded, effective

steps.name: Warm up
steps.cue: Arm circles, squats with no weight, a few good breaths.

steps.name: Goblet squats
steps.cue: One weight at the chest. Sit down, stand tall.

steps.name: Rows
steps.cue: Hinge forward, pull the elbows back past your ribs.

steps.name: Overhead press
steps.cue: Ribs down, press straight up.

steps.name: Deadlift
steps.cue: Hinge at the hips, back long, weights close to your legs.

steps.name: Finish
steps.cue: Shake out your hands, roll your shoulders.

sessions.title: Thirty minutes, full strength
sessions.subtitle: The proper one

steps.name: Warm up
steps.cue: Five minutes of easy movement until you're actually warm.

steps.name: Squats
steps.cue: Three sets. Rest properly between them.

steps.name: Deadlifts
steps.cue: Hinge, not squat. Back stays long.

steps.name: Press
steps.cue: Overhead or floor press, whichever your shoulders prefer.

steps.name: Rows
steps.cue: Pull to the ribs, pause, lower slowly.

steps.name: Carries
steps.cue: Walk with the weights until your grip says stop.

steps.name: Cool down
steps.cue: Stretch whatever is loudest.

sessions.title: Twenty minutes of qi gong
sessions.subtitle: Standing, slow, and quietly restorative

steps.name: Standing
steps.cue: Feet hip width, knees soft. Just stand for a minute.

steps.name: Lifting the sky
steps.cue: Arms rise with the breath in, sink with the breath out.

steps.name: Turning the waist
steps.cue: Loose arms swinging around the body.

steps.name: Cloud hands
steps.cue: Weight shifting side to side, hands passing the centre.

steps.name: Holding the ball
steps.cue: Slow, round, unhurried. Shoulders down.

steps.name: Drawing down
steps.cue: Palms trace down the front. Three times.

steps.name: Stand and close
steps.cue: One quiet minute before you go back to the day.

sessions.title: Twenty minutes of stretching
sessions.subtitle: For the days everything feels tight

steps.name: Breathe
steps.cue: On your back. Let the floor hold you.

steps.name: Hamstrings
steps.cue: Strap, towel or hands. Ninety seconds each side.

steps.name: Figure four
steps.cue: Both sides, slow.

steps.name: Low lunge
steps.cue: Hips forward, breathe into the front of the back leg.

steps.name: Thoracic opening
steps.cue: Side-lying book openers. Follow your hand with your eyes.

steps.name: Child's pose
steps.cue: Knees wide, arms long.

steps.name: Legs up the wall
steps.cue: Finish here if there's a wall nearby.

sessions.title: A thirty minute walk
sessions.subtitle: Outside, phone in your pocket

steps.name: Head out
steps.cue: First five minutes are always the hardest. Just get outside.

steps.name: Settle into it
steps.cue: Find a pace you could hold a conversation at.

steps.name: Pick it up
steps.cue: If you feel like it, walk a bit faster for a few minutes.

steps.name: Ease back
steps.cue: Slow down for the last stretch home.

sessions.title: Twenty minutes of dancing
sessions.subtitle: No choreography, no mirror

steps.name: Pick the music
steps.cue: Something you actually like. This matters more than the movement.

steps.name: Start small
steps.cue: Shoulders, hips, feet. Let it build.

steps.name: Full out
steps.cue: Nobody's watching. Change songs whenever you want.

steps.name: Wind down
steps.cue: Slow the last song down, breathe, shake out your arms.

sessions.title: Twenty minutes of flow
sessions.subtitle: Warm, steady, breath-led

steps.name: Child's pose
steps.cue: Start here. Let the breath get long.

steps.name: Cat cow
steps.cue: Move with the breath, not with the count.

steps.name: Down dog and lunges
steps.cue: Step forward, sink the hips, breathe.

steps.name: Standing sequence
steps.cue: Whatever shape you know. Hold each one for five breaths.

steps.name: Balance
steps.cue: One leg. Wobbling is the work.

steps.name: Twists
steps.cue: Seated, both sides.

steps.name: Final rest (Savasana)
steps.cue: Flat on your back. Don't skip this part.

sessions.title: A forty-five minute ride
sessions.subtitle: Steady, outside, nowhere in particular

steps.name: Roll out easy
steps.cue: Ten easy minutes before you ask anything of your legs.

steps.name: Steady
steps.cue: A pace you could hold for an hour.

steps.name: Two harder efforts
steps.cue: Three minutes on, three minutes easy. Skip if you'd rather.

steps.name: Spin home
steps.cue: Light gear, easy legs.

sessions.title: Calf stretch while the kettle boils
sessions.subtitle: Two birds

steps.name: Front foot forward (Right)
steps.cue: Hands on the counter, one leg back, heel down.

steps.name: Bend the back knee (Right)
steps.cue: Same position, soft back knee. Different part of the calf.

steps.name: Front foot forward (Left)
steps.cue: Match it.

steps.name: Bend the back knee (Left)
steps.cue: Then pour the tea.

sessions.title: Walk your next call
sessions.subtitle: Same call, different body

steps.name: Headphones in
steps.cue: Before it starts, not five minutes into it.

steps.name: Walk
steps.cue: Anywhere. Around the block, up and down the hall.

steps.name: Finish standing
steps.cue: Roll your shoulders out before you sit back down.

sessions.title: Shoulder reset between meetings
sessions.subtitle: Five minutes, no floor needed

steps.name: Doorway chest stretch (Right)
steps.cue: Forearm on the frame, turn away gently.

steps.name: Doorway chest stretch (Left)
steps.cue: Match it.

steps.name: Thread the needle
steps.cue: Seated is fine. Reach one arm under the other.

steps.name: Neck side stretch
steps.cue: Both sides, slow.

sessions.title: Stand on one leg while you brush your teeth
sessions.subtitle: Free balance practice

steps.name: One leg
steps.cue: Top half of your teeth. Hold the sink if you need to.

steps.name: Other leg
steps.cue: Bottom half.

steps.name: Eyes closed, briefly
steps.cue: Only if you're near something to hold.

sessions.title: Five minutes of skater bounds
sessions.subtitle: Quick feet, side to side

steps.name: Warm up
steps.cue: March on the spot, then small side steps.

steps.name: Bound
steps.cue: Push off one foot, land softly on the other.

steps.name: Rest & shake out
steps.cue: Breathe.

steps.name: Bound again
steps.cue: Quicker if it feels good, smaller if it doesn't.

steps.name: Rest & shake out
steps.cue: Shake out.

steps.name: Last set
steps.cue: Then walk it off for thirty seconds.

sessions.title: Carry the shopping in one trip
sessions.subtitle: Grip work that was happening anyway

steps.name: Load up
steps.cue: Split the weight evenly between both hands.

steps.name: Stand tall
steps.cue: Shoulders back, ribs down. This is the whole exercise.

steps.name: Walk it in
steps.cue: Slow and steady. Put things down before your grip fails.

steps.name: Open your hands
steps.cue: Stretch the fingers wide a few times.

sessions.title: Dance to three songs
sessions.subtitle: That's it. That's the session.

steps.name: Song one
steps.cue: Whatever's stuck in your head.

steps.name: Song two
steps.cue: Something faster.

steps.name: Song three
steps.cue: Something you'd be embarrassed to admit you love.

sessions.title: Long shower, then legs up the wall
sessions.subtitle: The good kind of doing nothing

steps.name: Shower
steps.cue: As long as you like. As hot as you like.

steps.name: Legs up the wall
steps.cue: Five quiet minutes before bed.

sessions.title: Ten minutes in the light
sessions.subtitle: Especially good early

steps.name: Go outside
steps.cue: No headphones, if you can stand it.

steps.name: Walk
steps.cue: Look at things that are far away.

steps.name: Come back
steps.cue: That's the whole thing.

sessions.title: Go for a skate
sessions.subtitle: Because it's fun, which is the point

steps.name: Get set up
steps.cue: Pads on. Yes, really.

steps.name: Easy laps
steps.cue: Find your legs again.

steps.name: Play
steps.cue: Whatever you feel like doing.

steps.name: Finish
steps.cue: Stop while it's still fun.

sessions.title: Swim
sessions.subtitle: Worth planning the trip for

steps.name: Easy laps
steps.cue: Ten minutes of nothing hard.

steps.name: Steady set
steps.cue: Break it up however you like. Rest at the wall.

steps.name: Easy again
steps.cue: Finish feeling good, not finished.

sessions.title: A reformer class
sessions.subtitle: Book it, put it in the calendar

steps.name: Arrive early
steps.cue: Five minutes to settle beats arriving flustered.

steps.name: The class
steps.cue: Follow the teacher. Ask for the version that suits your body.

sessions.title: Play pickleball
sessions.subtitle: Quick feet, and a laugh

steps.name: Warm up
steps.cue: Move side to side before you play. The ankles will thank you.

steps.name: Play
steps.cue: Rest between games properly.

steps.name: Stretch after
steps.cue: Calves and hips, five minutes.

sessions.title: A climbing session
sessions.subtitle: New patterns, strong hands

steps.name: Warm up
steps.cue: Easy routes first. Always.

steps.name: Climb
steps.cue: Rest as long as you climb.

steps.name: Hands and forearms
steps.cue: Stretch them out before you leave.

sessions.title: Two heavy things, one lap
sessions.subtitle: The simplest thing in the building

steps.name: Pick your weight
steps.cue: Two dumbbells you can hold, not two you have to fight.

steps.name: Walk
steps.cue: Tall, slow, shoulders down. Walk until your grip tells you.

steps.name: Set down and breathe
steps.cue: Put them down before your grip gives out, not after.

steps.name: Once more
steps.cue: Same walk, same pace. That's the whole thing.

sessions.title: Twenty minutes on the machines
sessions.subtitle: Nothing to set up, nothing to balance

steps.name: Settle in
steps.cue: Walk a couple of minutes. Roll your shoulders. No rush.

steps.name: Leg press
steps.cue: Feet flat, push through your whole foot, don't lock out hard.

steps.name: Chest press
steps.cue: Elbows a little below your shoulders, press away and back.

steps.name: Lat pulldown
steps.cue: Sit tall, pull the bar to your collarbone, let it rise slowly.

steps.name: Seated row
steps.cue: Pull the handle to your ribs and let your shoulder blades come together.

steps.name: Finish
steps.cue: Shake out your hands. A slow walk to the door.

sessions.title: Thirty minutes on the gym floor
sessions.subtitle: The whole body, one round at a time

steps.name: Warm up
steps.cue: Five minutes of easy walking, then arm circles and a few squats with nothing in your hands.

steps.name: Goblet squats
steps.cue: One weight at the chest. Sit down between your feet, stand tall.

steps.name: Romanian deadlift
steps.cue: Hips back, back long, weights close to your legs the whole way.

steps.name: Lat pulldown
steps.cue: Sit tall and pull the bar down to your collarbone.

steps.name: Overhead press
steps.cue: Ribs down, press straight up, let the weight come back slowly.

steps.name: Carry to finish
steps.cue: Two heavy things, one lap of the floor, then put them down.

sessions.title: Eight minutes of pulling
sessions.subtitle: For a back that spent the day at a desk

steps.name: Seated row
steps.cue: Light. Pull to your ribs, let your shoulder blades come together, release slowly.

steps.name: Lat pulldown
steps.cue: Sit tall. Pull to your collarbone, and let the bar rise all the way back up.

steps.name: Doorway or rack stretch
steps.cue: One forearm on the upright, turn gently away from it.

sessions.title: Sauna, then the quiet mat in the corner
sessions.subtitle: The part of the membership nobody uses

steps.name: Heat
steps.cue: Sit. Take your time getting out. Water afterwards.

steps.name: Child's pose
steps.cue: Knees wide, forehead down, let your shoulders go.

steps.name: Figure four
steps.cue: One ankle over the opposite knee, draw the legs in until you feel it.

sessions.title: Living room floor unwind
sessions.subtitle: Ten minutes off your feet

steps.name: Get on the floor
steps.cue: Carpet, rug, or mat. Lie on your back.

steps.name: Knees to chest
steps.cue: Gentle rock side to side.

steps.name: Constructive rest
steps.cue: Feet flat on the floor, knees bent together, hands on belly.

steps.name: Roll up
steps.cue: Take your time coming up.

sessions.title: Barefoot porch breath
sessions.subtitle: Five minutes of fresh air and stillness

steps.name: Step out
steps.cue: Barefoot on the porch, balcony, or by an open window.

steps.name: Box breathing
steps.cue: Inhale for 4, hold for 4, exhale for 4, hold for 4.

steps.name: Look at the horizon
steps.cue: Soft gaze into the distance.

sessions.title: Favorite playlist groove
sessions.subtitle: Two songs, zero rules

steps.name: Pick two tracks
steps.cue: Put on whatever makes you smile.

steps.name: Move freely
steps.cue: Sway, tap, or shake out whatever feels stiff.

steps.name: Deep breath
steps.cue: One long exhale to close.

sessions.title: Tea and quiet floor stretch
sessions.subtitle: Gentle restorative unwinding

steps.name: Child's pose
steps.cue: Sit back on your heels, reach forward softly.

steps.name: Seated side reach
steps.cue: Right arm up and over, then left.

steps.name: Quiet stillness
steps.cue: Sip your tea or just close your eyes.

sessions.title: Park bench quiet stretch
sessions.subtitle: Ten minutes in the open air

steps.name: Find a bench
steps.cue: Sit tall, feet flat on the grass or path.

steps.name: Seated figure four
steps.cue: Ankle over knee, gentle lean forward.

steps.name: Chest opener
steps.cue: Hands behind bench, open the collarbones.

steps.name: Breathe
steps.cue: Listen to the park around you.

sessions.title: Doorway chest and spine opener
sessions.subtitle: Counteract hours of sitting

steps.name: Doorway stretch
steps.cue: Forearms on the door frame, step gently through.

steps.name: Thoracic rotation
steps.cue: Hands behind head, gentle twists side to side.

steps.name: Shoulder rolls
steps.cue: Roll shoulders backward 5 times, forward 5 times.

sessions.title: Calf raises while brushing teeth
sessions.subtitle: Two minutes of ankle and calf strength

steps.name: Slow calf raises
steps.cue: Rise up on toes, pause, lower slowly for 3 seconds.

steps.name: Single leg hold
steps.cue: 60 seconds per side standing tall.

steps.name: Ankle circles
steps.cue: Clockwise and counterclockwise.

sessions.title: Desk wrist and forearm reset
sessions.subtitle: Five minutes for tired hands and forearms

steps.name: Forearm extensor stretch
steps.cue: Arm straight, pull fingertips down gently.

steps.name: Forearm flexor stretch
steps.cue: Arm straight, pull fingertips back towards wrist.

steps.name: Finger fan and fist
steps.cue: Spread fingers wide, make gentle fists.

sessions.title: Five minutes of stairs
sessions.subtitle: Quick leg drive on the bottom step

steps.name: Rhythm step-ups
steps.cue: Step up, step down on the bottom stair.

steps.name: Rest and shake out
steps.cue: Breathe.

steps.name: Side step-ups
steps.cue: 60s leading left, 60s leading right.

steps.name: Calf stretch on the edge
steps.cue: Heel drop off the step edge.

sessions.title: One lap around the block
sessions.subtitle: Fresh air between tasks

steps.name: Step out
steps.cue: Lace up and head out the front door.

steps.name: Brisk walk
steps.cue: Natural stride, arms swinging freely.

steps.name: Cool down walk
steps.cue: Slow pace back to your door.

sessions.title: Desk chair squat breaks
sessions.subtitle: Wake up sleepy glutes and hips right at your office chair

steps.name: Stand in front of your chair
steps.cue: Feet hip-width apart, toes slightly turned out. Roll shoulders back.

steps.name: Hover squats (10 reps)
steps.cue: Hinge hips back, tap glutes lightly to the seat without sitting, and drive up through heels.

steps.name: Standing glute squeeze holds
steps.cue: Stand tall, tuck your pelvis slightly, and squeeze glutes firmly for 3 seconds per rep.

steps.name: Second round hover squats (10 reps)
steps.cue: Keep chest proud and knees tracking over toes. Feel blood flow returning to your legs.

sessions.title: Hip flexor & glute reset
sessions.subtitle: Decompress tight hip flexors and open the lower back after hours of sitting

steps.name: Standing hip flexor reach (Right)
steps.cue: Step right foot back, tuck tailbone slightly, and reach right arm up and over to feel the front hip open.

steps.name: Standing hip flexor reach (Left)
steps.cue: Step left foot back, tuck tailbone, and reach left arm high. Breathe into the front hip crease.

steps.name: Seated figure-4 hip stretch
steps.cue: Sit on the edge of your chair, cross right ankle over left knee, and gently lean forward with a flat back. Switch sides halfway.

steps.name: Standing wide hip circles
steps.cue: Hands on your hips, make big slow circles clockwise and counter-clockwise to lubricate hip joints.

sessions.title: All-day desk worker reset
sessions.subtitle: Complete 15-minute anti-sitting routine: deep squat holds, wall angels, thoracic openers, and lunge pulses

steps.name: Chest opener & wall angels
steps.cue: Back flat against the wall, elbows bent at 90 degrees. Slide arms overhead while keeping ribcage down to undo rounded shoulders.

steps.name: Supported deep squat hold & hip pry
steps.cue: Hold onto a desk or doorframe, sink into a deep squat, and shift weight side to side to open ankles and hips.

steps.name: Low lunge pulses & thoracic twists
steps.cue: Step into a runner's lunge, drop back knee, reach same-side arm toward ceiling for a gentle twist. Switch sides after 2 minutes.

steps.name: Glute bridge holds & pelvic tilts
steps.cue: Lie on the floor or mat, drive through heels to lift hips into bridge, and hold for 5 seconds at the top to wake up dormant glutes.

steps.name: Standing quad stretch & side body reach
steps.cue: Hold onto desk for balance, draw heel to glute, and tuck tailbone. Switch sides.

sessions.title: Coffee break counter squats
sessions.subtitle: Turn waiting for the kettle or microwave into an effortless lower-body circulation boost

steps.name: Kettle start & stance set
steps.cue: Start your coffee or microwave, face the kitchen counter, and place feet shoulder-width apart.

steps.name: Counter-tap tempo squats (15 reps)
steps.cue: Smoothly squat down and stand tall, lightly touching the counter for rhythm. Keep your weight distributed across the whole foot.

steps.name: Calf raise pumps
steps.cue: Rise up high onto toes, hold for 1 second, and lower down to pump blood back up the legs.

steps.name: Take your fresh cup & walk
steps.cue: Grab your drink feeling energized and refreshed.

sessions.title: The single-song dance party
sessions.subtitle: Blast your favorite track and dance completely uninhibited for 3 minutes

steps.name: Queue your song
steps.cue: Pick the highest-energy, zero-judgment song on your playlist and turn the volume up.

steps.name: Shake out hands & shoulders
steps.cue: Loosen your wrists, drop your shoulders, and let the bass take over.

steps.name: Dance uninhibited
steps.cue: No choreography, no performance. Jump, spin, flail, or groove however your body wants.

steps.name: Final breath & stillness
steps.cue: Song fades. Hands on your chest, feel your heartbeat and breathe in deep.

sessions.title: Sunlight strut
sessions.subtitle: Step outside barefoot onto the grass or porch for a 5-minute deep-breathing session

steps.name: Step outside barefoot
steps.cue: Kick off your shoes and step onto the grass, deck, or patio. Feel the ground beneath you.

steps.name: Ground your feet
steps.cue: Spread your toes into the earth. Turn your face toward the natural light.

steps.name: Deep rhythmic breathing
steps.cue: Inhale crisp open air for 4 seconds, exhale slowly for 6. Let your shoulders soften.

steps.name: Slow grounding strut
steps.cue: Take slow, deliberate barefoot steps. Notice the temperature and texture underfoot.

sessions.title: Desk escape stretch
sessions.subtitle: Quick neck, shoulder, and wrist decompression routine

steps.name: Stand & step back
steps.cue: Push your chair away from the desk and stand tall with feet hip-width apart.

steps.name: Neck side stretch & rolls
steps.cue: Tilt right ear to right shoulder, breathe into the left side. Gently switch to the other side.

steps.name: Shoulder shrugs & chest opener
steps.cue: Roll shoulders up, back, and down. Clasp hands behind your back and open the collarbones.

steps.name: Wrist circles & forearm stretch
steps.cue: Circle your wrists both ways. Extend one arm forward and gently draw fingertips back.

steps.name: Full upper body shakeout
steps.cue: Shake out arms, bounce lightly on your heels, and reset for the rest of your day.

sessions.title: Power explosions
sessions.subtitle: Fire up your nervous system with fast jumping jacks or bodyweight squats

steps.name: Set your stance & shake it out
steps.cue: Stand with feet ready. Take one big breath to summon quick power.

steps.name: First explosion: 15 rapid reps
steps.cue: Power through 15 fast jumping jacks or snappy bodyweight squats. Quick, sharp, alive.

steps.name: Active recovery breath
steps.cue: Hands on hips. Deep inhale, slow exhale while pacing in place.

steps.name: Second explosion: 15 rapid reps
steps.cue: Match the speed or go slightly faster. Light on your feet, full extension at the top.

steps.name: Grounding breath
steps.cue: Stand tall, palms forward. Feel the energetic pulse humming through your body.

sessions.title: Audio tracking
sessions.subtitle: Pair a gripping narrative podcast exclusively with laundry or kitchen chores

steps.name: Cue your story
steps.cue: Slip headphones on and press play on a story podcast you only allow yourself to hear while moving.

steps.name: Active chore flow
steps.cue: Fold, wipe, sort, or tidy with steady, continuous physical momentum while your mind gets lost in the narrative.

steps.name: Pause & appreciate
steps.cue: Hit pause on a cliffhanger, take off headphones, and admire the clean space you just created.

sessions.title: Aromatherapy movement reset
sessions.subtitle: Mist your space with citrus or eucalyptus spray before physical tasks

steps.name: Mist the room
steps.cue: Spritz an energizing citrus, mint, or eucalyptus spray generously into your workspace.

steps.name: Three clearing breaths
steps.cue: Close your eyes, breathe the scent all the way into the lower ribs, and exhale fully.

steps.name: Gentle standing twists
steps.cue: Let your arms swing loosely around your torso in rhythm with the fresh scent.

steps.name: Step into motion
steps.cue: Open your eyes, take a sip of water, and carry that sensory clarity straight into your task.

sessions.title: Sonic focus
sessions.subtitle: High-tempo lo-fi, synthwave, or game soundtracks to turn chores into a game

steps.name: Drop the needle
steps.cue: Queue up driving synthwave, racing game soundtracks, or high-tempo lo-fi beats.

steps.name: Define your arena
steps.cue: Pick one room or one surface to conquer before the track ends.

steps.name: Speed clearing quest
steps.cue: Move to the beat. Treat every item returned to its place like a quest checkpoint.

steps.name: Victory pose & stretch
steps.cue: Throw your hands up in victory, take a long stretch upward, and celebrate the completed run.

sessions.title: Active posture shift
sessions.subtitle: Trade your desk chair for a stability ball or under-desk walking pad during calls

steps.name: Swap your seat
steps.cue: Roll in your stability ball or power on your under-desk pad at low walking speed.

steps.name: Align your spine
steps.cue: Stack your ribcage over your pelvis. Keep your chin level and shoulders relaxed.

steps.name: Continuous micro-movement
steps.cue: Maintain a gentle pelvic rhythm on the ball or a steady easy stride during your casual meeting.

steps.name: Step off & calf stretch
steps.cue: Step off, place hands on desk, and press one heel back into the floor to release calf tension.

sessions.title: The discovery walk
sessions.subtitle: Map out a brand new neighborhood route or trail for a novelty boost

steps.name: Lace up & pick the unknown turn
steps.cue: Shoes on. Decide right now to take the street, alley, or fork you've never walked down before.

steps.name: Novelty outward march
steps.cue: Walk at a brisk, comfortable pace. Spot 5 architectural details or plants you never noticed.

steps.name: Deep loop exploration
steps.cue: Follow the trail or side street where it leads. Keep your gaze up and off the phone screen.

steps.name: Relaxed return stride
steps.cue: Ease your pace as you head back home. Let your arms swing freely and breathe deeply.

sessions.title: Mindful yoga flow
sessions.subtitle: Unroll your mat for a structured 30-minute Vinyasa & deep Yin breathing session

steps.name: Centering & belly breathing
steps.cue: Sit cross-legged or kneel on your mat. Place hands on lower belly and match breath to 4-in, 4-out.

steps.name: Cat-cow & gentle spinal waves
steps.cue: Move between arched back on the inhale and rounded spine on the exhale. Flow with your rhythm.

steps.name: Vinyasa flow & standing warriors
steps.cue: Downward dog to lunges, Warrior II pulses, and open heart openers. Move smoothly without rushing.

steps.name: Deep Yin hip openers
steps.cue: Settle into Pigeon or Lizard pose on both sides. Surrender into the stretch and breathe into tightness.

steps.name: Reclined spinal twists
steps.cue: Lie on your back, draw knees to chest, and drop them gently to each side.

steps.name: Savasana still integration
steps.cue: Extend arms and legs wide on your mat. Total release into the floor.

sessions.title: Sweat investment circuit
sessions.subtitle: 30-minute targeted kettlebell circuit or high-intensity bodyweight strength

steps.name: Dynamic joint warm-up
steps.cue: Arm circles, hip hinges, world's greatest stretch, and light bodyweight squats to prime the engine.

steps.name: Block 1: Power & legs
steps.cue: Alternate between 10 kettlebell / dumbbell goblet squats and 15 explosive hip swings. 3 rounds.

steps.name: Block 2: Upper body push-pull
steps.cue: Push-ups or dumbbell overhead presses paired with bent-over rows. Smooth control on every rep.

steps.name: Block 3: Core & lunge burn
steps.cue: Alternating reverse lunges into 45-second hollow body or forearm plank holds.

steps.name: Cool-down & deep recovery
steps.cue: Child's pose and standing quad stretches. Let your heart rate glide back down to baseline.

sessions.title: Local studio session
sessions.subtitle: Book an intro movement class or group fitness session for community energy

steps.name: Arrive & settle in
steps.cue: Step into the studio, sign in, kick off your coat, and soak in the buzzing community energy.

steps.name: Instructor guided warm-up
steps.cue: Follow along with the group warm-up. Match the collective rhythm in the room.

steps.name: Main class block
steps.cue: Ride the group momentum through the main choreography, intervals, or guided sequences.

steps.name: Group cool-down & connection
steps.cue: Group stretches, breath together, and a shared round of applause with your fellow movers.

sessions.title: Guided foam rolling
sessions.subtitle: Roll out sore muscles while catching up on a single 15-minute video

steps.name: Queue your video & mat setup
steps.cue: Pick exactly one 15-minute video reward, prop your screen up, and place your foam roller on the mat.

steps.name: Calves & hamstrings rolling
steps.cue: Slow passes along the lower legs. Pause and breathe gently over any tender trigger points.

steps.name: Glutes & piriformis release
steps.cue: Cross one ankle over the opposite knee on the roller. Lean slightly into the outer hip.

steps.name: Upper back & thoracic roll
steps.cue: Support your head with your hands, roller across mid-back. Gently arch and roll upper ribs.

steps.name: Lying flat integration
steps.cue: Move roller aside, lay completely flat on the mat, and let your muscles soak in the blood flow.

sessions.title: Luxury recovery soak
sessions.subtitle: A hot bath infused with Epsom salts immediately following movement

steps.name: Draw the bath & Epsom salt prep
steps.cue: Run hot water, pour in 2 cups of Epsom salts, and dim the bathroom lights.

steps.name: Submerge & settle
steps.cue: Step in slowly, ease shoulders beneath the waterline, and let the warm mineral water hold you.

steps.name: Deep muscular relaxation soak
steps.cue: Close your eyes. Feel magnesium soothing tired tissue with every long, unhurried exhale.

steps.name: Gentle seated neck & shoulder stretches
steps.cue: Slowly roll your neck and stretch shoulders in the steam before stepping out into a towel.

sessions.title: Nature immersion hike
sessions.subtitle: Hike a scenic trail or explore a provincial/national park for a mental reset

steps.name: Pack water & trail prep
steps.cue: Pack a water bottle, trail snack, and lace up your hiking boots at the trailhead.

steps.name: Trailhead start & steady uphill cadence
steps.cue: Set a steady, unhurried uphill stride. Tune into the sound of leaves, wind, and your footsteps.

steps.name: Lookout rest & mindful grounding
steps.cue: Reach the summit or scenic viewpoint. Sit down, sip water, and gaze into the open horizon.

steps.name: Forest descent & deep breathing
steps.cue: Navigate the descent with soft knees, inhaling forest air and soaking in the calm vitality.

sessions.title: Spa & sauna thermal cycles
sessions.subtitle: Infrared sauna sessions, cold plunges, or massage therapy for deep restoration

steps.name: Warm shower & hydration prep
steps.cue: Rinse off with a warm shower, drink a large glass of electrolyte water, and enter the quiet thermal space.

steps.name: Thermal heat soak / sauna cycle 1
steps.cue: Sit or lie in the sauna or hot bath. Let heat penetrate joints and induce full-body sweating.

steps.name: Cold plunge or cool rinse reset
steps.cue: Step into the cold plunge or cool shower for 1 to 3 minutes. Focus on controlled, steady exhales.

steps.name: Rest & hydration lounge
steps.cue: Wrap in a warm robe and recline in the lounge. Feel the vascular flush and deep tranquility.

steps.name: Second sauna & cool cycle
steps.cue: Return to the heat for round two, followed by a final refreshing cool rinse.

steps.name: Integration & light mobility
steps.cue: Gentle seated spinal twists and hip openers in the relaxation lounge before heading out.

sessions.title: 1-on-1 performance coaching
sessions.subtitle: Personalized guided training or physical rehab session to break past plateaus

steps.name: Movement screen & check-in
steps.cue: Assess range of motion, review recent training fatigue, and calibrate the day's focus with your coach.

steps.name: Targeted activation & joint prep
steps.cue: Band-resisted activation, scapular glides, and hip stabilization to prepare for complex loads.

steps.name: Primary lift / skill progression
steps.cue: Coached technique execution under appropriate load with real-time cues and biomechanical feedback.

steps.name: Accessory & stability circuits
steps.cue: High-yield unilateral stability, core bracing, or tempo exercises to fix movement asymmetries.

steps.name: Post-session debrief & recovery plan
steps.cue: Review wins, document form takeaways, and map out mobility homework for the week.

sessions.title: Five-minute shake-out
sessions.subtitle: Release physical tension and reset your nervous system

steps.name: Settle & breathe
steps.cue: Stand comfortably. Let your shoulders drop away from your ears and take a slow exhale.

steps.name: Shake arms & wrists
steps.cue: Shake your hands and arms freely, as if flicking water from your fingertips.

steps.name: Catch your breath
steps.cue: Pause and notice the tingling warmth in your hands and shoulders.

steps.name: Shake legs & hips
steps.cue: Shake one leg, then the other. Let your hips and calves loosen up.

steps.name: Catch your breath
steps.cue: Stand still, feeling grounded through the soles of your feet.

steps.name: Full body shake
steps.cue: Bounce softly on your heels and shake everything loose from head to toe.

steps.name: Quiet integration
steps.cue: Stand tall, eyes soft or closed. Feel your nervous system settle into ease.

sessions.title: Two-minute power pose
sessions.subtitle: Stand tall, open your chest, and restore quiet confidence

steps.name: Take up space
steps.cue: Feet hip-width apart, hands firmly on hips. Roll your shoulders back and open your collarbones.

steps.name: Hold & breathe deep
steps.cue: Keep your chin level, chest wide. Inhale slowly into your belly, exhale slow and steady.

steps.name: Ground & soften
steps.cue: Release your arms gently. Keep the upright dignity in your spine as you move into the day.

sessions.title: Ten-minute brisk walk
sessions.subtitle: Clear brain fog, elevate heart rate, and trigger natural dopamine

steps.name: Easy start
steps.cue: Begin walking at a relaxed pace. Let your arms swing naturally and relax your jaw.

steps.name: Brisk stride
steps.cue: Pick up the tempo to a purposeful cadence. Breathe rhythmically as blood flow wakes up your mind.

steps.name: Steady coast
steps.cue: Maintain your stride. Notice your surroundings without rushing your thoughts.

sessions.title: Five-minute dance it out
sessions.subtitle: Put on your favorite track and let your body move freely

steps.name: Find the rhythm
steps.cue: Start swaying, tapping your feet, or rolling your shoulders to the beat.

steps.name: Free movement
steps.cue: No choreography needed. Shake, bounce, groove—let your body lead without judgment.

steps.name: Cool down sway
steps.cue: Slow the tempo down. Deep breath in through your nose, easy sigh out through your mouth.

sessions.title: Progressive muscle relaxation
sessions.subtitle: Systematically tense and release from toes to crown to unwind deeply

steps.name: Lie down & settle
steps.cue: Find a comfortable position lying on your back or couch. Close your eyes and breathe gently.

steps.name: Feet & calves
steps.cue: Curl your toes and squeeze your calves tight for 5 seconds... now completely release. Feel the warmth.

steps.name: Thighs & glutes
steps.cue: Firmly tighten your thighs and glutes for 5 seconds... release and let your legs sink into the floor.

steps.name: Hands & arms
steps.cue: Make fists and flex your arms for 5 seconds... let go and feel all holding drain from your fingertips.

steps.name: Shoulders & chest
steps.cue: Shrug shoulders toward your ears and tighten your chest... exhale and let them drop heavy and loose.

steps.name: Face & jaw
steps.cue: Scrunch your forehead, eyes, and clench your jaw... exhale and let every line in your face soften.

steps.name: Total body release
steps.cue: Rest in deep, effortless stillness. Notice how light and relaxed your whole body feels.

sessions.title: Cold water splash reset
sessions.subtitle: Activate the dive reflex to instantly calm a racing heart

steps.name: Prepare cool water
steps.cue: Run cold tap water over your hands or get an ice cube ready.

steps.name: Splash & breathe
steps.cue: Splash cold water across your face, cheeks, and forehead. Feel the immediate thermal sensation.

steps.name: Long slow exhale
steps.cue: Pat your face dry with a towel and take one long, slow exhale. Notice your pulse slowing.

sessions.title: Stretch and breathe
sessions.subtitle: Five gentle physical resets for when you have been sitting too long

steps.name: Slow neck rolls
steps.cue: Gently circle your ear toward one shoulder, down across your chest, and to the other side.

steps.name: Shoulder circles
steps.cue: Roll your shoulders backward in large, fluid circles, syncing each lift with an inhale.

steps.name: Side bend
steps.cue: Reach one arm up and curve gently to the side, opening your ribs. Switch sides smoothly.

steps.name: Soft forward fold
steps.cue: Bend your knees softly and fold forward. Let your head hang like a heavy fruit.

steps.name: Open chest & breathe
steps.cue: Clasp hands behind your back or place on your hips, open your chest, and breathe deeply.

sessions.title: Gratitude body scan
sessions.subtitle: Five peaceful minutes appreciating everything your body carried today

steps.name: Close your eyes & arrive
steps.cue: Sit or lie down quietly. Let your body rest without needing to produce or perform.

steps.name: Thank your feet & legs
steps.cue: Bring gentle attention to your legs and feet. Silently acknowledge how many steps they carried you today.

steps.name: Thank your back & core
steps.cue: Notice your spine and chest. Acknowledge your heart beating and lungs breathing effortlessly.

steps.name: Thank your hands & arms
steps.cue: Rest awareness in your hands. Appreciate everything they helped you build, write, and touch today.

steps.name: Full body integration
steps.cue: Take a deep, grateful breath for your whole self. Let a quiet smile soften your face.

sessions.title: Two-minute jumping jacks burst
sessions.subtitle: Quick cardio intervals to break through inertia and kickstart motivation

steps.name: Light bounce in place
steps.cue: Shake out your wrists and bounce lightly on the balls of your feet.

steps.name: Burst interval one
steps.cue: Jumping jacks at a lively rhythm. Land lightly on soft knees.

steps.name: Breathe & recover
steps.cue: Hands on your hips, stand tall, take two full inhales.

steps.name: Burst interval two
steps.cue: Final burst! Feel the oxygen and endorphins energizing your entire body.

steps.name: Land & feel the buzz
steps.cue: Stand still with palms forward. Notice your energized pulse and awake mind.

glossary.name: Dead bug
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent over your hips and your arms reaching to the ceiling.
Press your lower back gently into the floor and keep it there the whole time.
Lower one arm behind you and straighten the opposite leg toward the floor.
Only go as far as you can while your back stays down. Return and switch sides.

glossary.name: Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat and hip width apart.
Press through your heels and lift your hips, peeling your spine off the floor one bit at a time.
Pause at the top without arching your lower back.
Lower slowly, the same way you came up.

glossary.name: The hundred
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent over your hips.
Lift your head and shoulders if that's comfortable, and reach your arms long by your sides.
Pump your arms up and down in small movements.
Breathe in for five pumps and out for five pumps, ten times.

glossary.name: Single leg stretch
instructions: Lie on your back and draw one knee toward your chest.
Extend the other leg away at whatever height keeps your lower back heavy on the floor.
Switch legs smoothly, as if pedalling slowly.
Keep your shoulders relaxed away from your ears.

glossary.name: Side plank
instructions: Lie on your side, propped on your forearm with your elbow under your shoulder.
Stack your feet, or drop the bottom knee to the floor for a version that is just as good.
Lift your hips so your body makes one long line.
Hold, breathing normally, then lower with control.

glossary.name: Plank
instructions: Set your forearms or hands under your shoulders and step your feet back.
Make one long line from your head to your heels, with your hips neither high nor sagging.
Knees down is a full version, not a lesser one.
Hold while you can breathe steadily, then rest.

glossary.name: Pelvic tilt
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Gently tilt your pelvis so your lower back flattens toward the floor.
Then tilt the other way so a small arch appears.
Rock slowly between the two. The movement is small.

glossary.name: Goblet squat
instructions: Hold one weight against your chest with both hands.
Stand with your feet a little wider than your hips, toes turned out slightly.
Sit your hips down and back, keeping your chest tall.
Press through the whole foot to stand up.

glossary.name: Deadlift
instructions: Stand holding weights in front of your thighs, knees softly bent.
Push your hips backward and let the weights travel close down your legs.
Stop when you feel a strong stretch at the back of your thighs.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall again.

glossary.name: Row
instructions: Hinge forward from the hips with a long back and soft knees.
Let the weights hang below your shoulders.
Pull your elbows back past your ribs, leading with the elbows rather than the hands.
Lower slowly and repeat.

glossary.name: Overhead press
instructions: Hold the weights at shoulder height with your elbows under your wrists.
Keep your ribs down so you don't arch your lower back.
Press straight up until your arms are long.
Lower under control to the start.

glossary.name: Carry
instructions: Pick up something heavy in each hand.
Stand tall with your shoulders back and your ribs down.
Walk slowly and evenly, breathing normally.
Put the weight down before your grip gives out, not after.

glossary.name: Jump rope
instructions: Stay on the balls of your feet with soft knees.
Jump only just high enough to clear the rope.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and turn the rope with your wrists.
Without a rope, the same small bounce still counts.

glossary.name: Skater bound
instructions: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Push sideways off that leg and land on the other foot.
Land quietly, letting the knee and hip bend to absorb it.
Start small. Bigger only when the landings stay soft.

glossary.name: Single leg stand
instructions: Stand on one foot with a soft knee.
Fix your eyes on something still.
Hold nearby support with a fingertip if you need to.
Wobbling is the work, not a failure.

glossary.name: Cat cow
instructions: On hands and knees, wrists under shoulders and knees under hips.
Breathe in and let your belly soften as your chest lifts.
Breathe out and round your back toward the ceiling.
Move with your breath rather than counting.

glossary.name: Child's pose
instructions: Kneel and sit your hips back toward your heels.
Take your knees as wide as is comfortable and reach your arms forward.
Rest your forehead on the floor, a cushion or your hands.
Stay for as many breaths as you like.

glossary.name: Low lunge
instructions: Step one foot forward and lower the back knee to the floor.
Bring your front knee over your ankle and let your hips sink forward.
Lift your chest and breathe into the front of the back thigh.
Pad the back knee with a folded towel if it's tender.

glossary.name: Figure four
instructions: Lie on your back with both knees bent.
Cross one ankle over the opposite thigh, just above the knee.
Reach through and draw the supporting leg toward you.
Keep your head and shoulders resting on the floor.

glossary.name: Hamstring stretch
instructions: Lie on your back and lift one leg toward the ceiling.
Loop a strap, towel or your hands around the back of that thigh.
Straighten the leg only as far as it stays comfortable.
Keep the other leg bent with the foot on the floor if your back prefers it.

glossary.name: Calf stretch
instructions: Stand facing a wall or counter with your hands on it.
Step one foot back and press that heel toward the floor.
Keep the back leg straight for the upper calf.
Then bend that knee slightly for the lower calf and achilles.

glossary.name: Neck side stretch
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Take one ear gently toward the same shoulder.
Let the opposite shoulder stay heavy rather than lifting.
Breathe into the long side of your neck. Never force it.

glossary.name: Chin tuck
instructions: Sit or stand tall and look straight ahead.
Draw your chin gently backward, as if making a double chin.
Hold for a breath and release.
The movement is small and should never hurt.

glossary.name: Doorway chest stretch
instructions: Place a forearm on a door frame with your elbow at shoulder height.
Step forward slightly and turn your body away from that arm.
Keep your ribs down and your shoulder relaxed.
Breathe, then switch sides.

glossary.name: Book opener
instructions: Lie on your side with your knees bent and stacked, arms reaching in front of you.
Slide the top hand along the bottom one, then open it wide toward the floor behind you.
Let your eyes follow your hand.
Keep your knees stacked and stay where you can still breathe easily.

glossary.name: Tree pose
instructions: Stand tall and shift your weight onto one foot.
Rest the other foot on your ankle, calf or inner thigh, never on the knee.
Find something still to look at.
Hold a wall or chair for as long as it's useful.

glossary.name: Legs up the wall
instructions: Sit sideways next to a wall, then swing your legs up it as you lie down.
Bring your hips as close to the wall as is comfortable.
Rest your arms wide and let the floor take your weight.
Come out slowly by bending your knees and rolling to one side.

glossary.name: Forearm stretch
instructions: Extend one arm in front of you with the palm facing down.
Use the other hand to gently draw the fingers toward you, then away.
Hold each direction for a few slow breaths.
Repeat on the other side.

glossary.name: Lat pulldown
instructions: Sit facing the machine with your thighs under the pads and take a wide hold of the bar.
Sit tall and pull the bar down towards your collarbone, leading with your elbows.
Let your shoulder blades slide down as the bar comes towards you.
Let the bar rise all the way back up under control before the next one.

glossary.name: Seated row
instructions: Sit with your feet on the platform and your knees softly bent.
Hold the handle with your arms straight and your back long.
Pull the handle towards your ribs, letting your shoulder blades come together.
Straighten your arms slowly and let your back stay long the whole time.

glossary.name: Leg press
instructions: Sit back in the seat with your feet flat on the platform, about hip width apart.
Push the platform away through your whole foot until your legs are nearly straight.
Stop short of locking your knees.
Bend your knees slowly to bring the platform back, keeping your lower back on the seat.

glossary.name: Chest press
instructions: Sit with your back against the pad and the handles roughly level with the middle of your chest.
Set your elbows a little below shoulder height rather than straight out to the sides.
Press the handles away until your arms are nearly straight.
Let them come back slowly until you feel a gentle stretch across your chest.
